name: Javier Lam
life: “I still remember demonstrating a new tool to somebody loyal to the old one.” People around the bank steps know Javier by a small Monday habit. Javier takes a few minutes to read the public notices, especially the ones written in a hurry.
voice: I sell folding ladders and offered a trade. They wanted the cedar smell, which mine will never have.
appearance: Javier is easy to recognize by a dark undercut with a longer wave on top and a crooked front tooth visible when laughing. Usually dressed in a moss-green cardigan with a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf, Javier rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket when listening.
personality: Javier gets protective of anybody who comes into a meeting unprepared. Javier privately wishes people would notice the amount of preparation behind this apparent ease.
agenda: To find a folding option without taking the cedar away.
family: Ashley Hsu is Javier’s half-sibling. Javier makes room at the table. Ashley brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *No lifeguard at dusk*, Ashley says, “I have watched this woman swim every evening.”
connections: Arlo Lee. The person carrying the ladder explains why a modern replacement is an awkward gift. Also in the story is Dario Moreau (crossing surveyor).

reactions.situation: A driver sounds a horn halfway through the crossing
reactions.response: Javier asks for a pause until the people carrying the ladder can clear the crossing safely.

reactions.situation: A stranger waves a phone camera in a crying person's face
reactions.response: Javier asks the filmer to lower the phone and gets another familiar face to stand by the person crying.

reactions.situation: If a colleague lies to save face
reactions.response: Javier offers one private chance to correct it before the next conversation.
